title: Chainsaw Man
synopsis: Denji is a teenage boy living with a Chainsaw Devil named Pochita. Due to the debt his father left behind, he has been living a rock-bottom life while repaying his debt by harvesting devil corpses with Pochita.

title: Attack on Titan: The Final Season
synopsis: The war for Paradis zeroes in on Shiganshina just as the Jaegerists have seized control. After taking a huge blow from a surprise attack led by Reiner, Eren scrambles to survive.

title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
synopsis: Goku and Vegeta encounter Broly, a Saiyan warrior unlike any fighter they have faced before.
